    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (B : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] (f : ∀ i, R →+* B i)
    (J : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Finite (J i)]
    (C : ∀ i, J i → Type u) [∀ i j, CommRing (C i j)]
